description: Tucked within the heart of Studio City's coveted Tujunga Village, this light-filled end-unit townhome offers the privacy and comfort of single-family-style living with only one shared wall and no neighbors above or below. Situated in an intimate 20-unit secured complex, the residence combines warmth, functionality, and an unbeatable location just moments from Woodbridge Park, beloved neighborhood cafs, restaurants, and studios.Inside, the spacious living and dining areas feature wood floors, a fireplace, and glass doors opening to a private balcony, creating an inviting indoor-outdoor flow. The galley-style eat-in kitchen is appointed with quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, apron-front sink, abundant cabinetry, and a dishwasher, while a powder room completes the main level. Upstairs, vaulted ceilings, oversized arched windows, and an abundance of natural light enhance two generously sized bedrooms and two updated bathrooms, including a primary ensuite. A conveniently located upstairs laundry area with included washer and dryer adds ease to everyday living. Additional amenities include central heat and air, newer HVAC, custom shutters, two secured subterranean tandem parking spaces, and a community pool. Ideally located near Universal City, CBS, Metro access, and major freeways, this is a rare opportunity to enjoy stylish living in one of Studio City's most sought-after neighborhoods.
